captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a flat, hollow-walled star polygon shape with seven sharp points. It consists of thin, straight vertical walls arranged in an overlapping star pattern, leaving hollow triangular sections at the tips and a central heptagonal opening. The structure is low-profile and uniform in height, resembling a decorative star-shaped cookie cutter or template.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable star polygon in OpenSCAD with a variable number of points (vertices), side length, wall thickness, and height. The script should calculate the appropriate internal angles and geometry to arrange the individual overlapping walls in a circular pattern.
captions.factory: The script defines a 'side' module representing one wall of the star, constructed using a 'cube' of the specified length, thickness, and height. It uses 'difference' and rotated 'cube' shapes to miter the ends of the wall at the correct angle. In the main loop, 'for' iterates 'p' times to rotate and translate each 'side' into its final position based on calculated trigonometric offsets (apothem and angle).
